# VerticalOpticalCouplingEfficiency

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The metric quantifying how effectively light is transferred between vertically stacked waveguides, often optimized via grating or adiabatic couplers. Directly impacts insertion loss and power budget in TCC's 3D optical networks, determining feasibility of dense vertical interconnects.
